edge_impulse_cubes_on_conveyor_belt.description: Annotated images of separated colored cubes on a real conveyor belt.
edge_impulse_cubes_on_conveyor_belt.credentials: No account or API key is required. Deployment requires git and git-lfs.
edge_impulse_cubes_on_conveyor_belt.evaluation_scope: Tune and train only on the training split; evaluate the frozen methods on testing.
limitations: The 15-image testing split is sufficient only for an initial smoke benchmark, not a strong general accuracy claim.
Images appear to include related capture sequences, so the published train/test split may contain near-neighbor leakage.
Color labels are collapsed to one cube class because the experiment evaluates detection and counting rather than color classification.
Still images support box-level and per-image count evaluation but cannot evaluate tracking, line crossing, duplicate temporal counts, or video FPS.
A final study should use a larger test set grouped by capture sequence and kept hidden until parameters are frozen.
